senses.gloss:
उद्घः [उद्-हन् अप् नि˚]
1
Excellence, eminence; (at the end
of comp.); ब्राह्मणोद्धः = an
excellent or superior Brāhmaṇa;
उद्घादयश्च नियतलिंगा न तु विशेष्यलिंगाः
Sk.; cf. मतल्लिकामचर्चिका
प्रकांडमुद्घतल्लजौ प्रशस्तवाचकान्यमूनि Ak.
--2
Happiness.
--3 The hollow hand.
--4 Fire.
--5 A model.
--6 Organic
air in the body.

उद्घनः A carpenter's bench (the
plank on which he works);
लौहोद्घनघनस्कंधां ललितापघनां स्त्रियं
Bk. 7. 62.
उद्घातिन् a. Uneven, rough.

उद्घट् {c1c} A. To open; Ku. 7. 53.
--Caus. (घाटयति)
1 To open,
unlock; निरयनगरद्वारमुद्घाटयंती
Bh. 1. 63; कपाटमुद्घाटयामि Mk. 3.
--2 To
peel off, shell.
--3 To reveal, expose,
make known.
--4 To undertake,
commence.
--5 To rub over, stroke
gently, tickle.
उद्घटितं A hint.
उद्घाटः A watch or guard-house.

1 A key; उद्घाटको
भवति यंत्रट्टढे कपाटे Mk. 3. 16.
--2 The
[]
rope and bucket of a well (--कं
also).

उद्घट्टकः A kind of time (in
music).

उद्घाटन a. (नी f.) Opening,
unlocking; धर्मं यो न करोति निंदितमतिः
स्वर्गार्गलोद्घाटनं H. 1. 153.
--नं
1
Opening; Ve. 1.
--2 Raising, lifting
up, hoisting.
--3 A key, any means
of opening.
--4 The rope and
bucket of a well; a water-wheel.

उद्घट्टनं, --ना
1 Friction, striking
against; Me. 61.
--2 Opening
upwards (as a lid).

उद्घाटित p. p.
1 Opened,
manifested.
--2 Undertaken;
commenced.
--3 Raised, lifted up.
--Comp.
--अंग a. {1} naked. {2} intelligent,
wise.
--ज्ञ a. wise, intelligent.

उद्घट्टित a.
1 Opened, unlocked.
--2 Separated; Śi. 11. 42.

उद्घट्टनं, --ना
1 Friction, striking
against; Me. 61.
--2 Opening
upwards (as a lid).
उद्घसं Flesh.

1 Beginning,
commencement; उद्घातः प्रणवो यासां Ku. 2. 12;
आकुमारकथोद्घातं शालिगोप्यो जगुर्यशः
R. 4. 20.
--2 Allusion, reference;
कथोद्घाताः U. 2.
--3 Striking,
wounding, inflicting an injury.
--4 A stroke,
blow, wound.
--5 Tripping, slipping,
jolting, shaking (as of a carriage);
ययावनुद्घातसुखेन सोऽध्वना Śi. 12. 2;
R. 2. 72; Ve. 2. 28; चक्र˚ V. 1;
U. 5. 1.
--6 Rising, elevation.
--7 A
club, mallet.
--8 A weapon (in
general).
--9 Breathing through the
nostrils as a religious exercise
(Wilson).
--10 A division of a
book, chapter; section.

उद्घुष् {c1c} P. To sound, cry out or
shout. {c10c} P. or Caus.
1 To
proclaim, declare aloud.
--2 To fill
with cries.

उद्घुष्ट p. p. Sounded out,
proclaimed.
--ष्टं A sound, noise.

1 Announcing aloud,
proclaiming.
--2 Popular talk, general
report.

उद्घृष् {c1c} P.
1 To rub; lessen by
rubbing.
--2 To rub over, strike
against.

1 Rubbing, rubbing up;
यस्योद्घर्षणलोष्टकैरपि सदा पृष्ठे न जातः
किणः Mk. 2. 11.
--2 Rubbing the
skin with hard substances.
--3 A
cudgel.

उद्घृष्टं A peculiar fault in
pronunciation.
